name: Kevin Donato Jimenez Rocha
title: Software Developer
bio: Software developer focused on building modern web and mobile applications with Django, React, React Native, and TypeScript. Passionate about creating efficient solutions, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into real-world projects.
aboutLong:
A software developer with experience building web and mobile applications using technologies such as Django, React, React Native, and TypeScript. I have worked on real-world projects developing both frontend and backend functionalities, integrating APIs, managing databases, and improving workflows through automation.

I enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and creating applications that are both functional and user-friendly. My goal is to continue growing professionally, contribute to meaningful projects, and strengthen my skills in full stack development while building solutions that create real impact.
